title: The Apricot Boundary
premise: In a quiet frontier village, aging orchard keeper Ada and carpenter Ben discover their shared fence was drawn incorrectly decades ago. Neither wants a feud. They test two repairs, laugh at the impractical one, and choose a shared gate that preserves Ada's apricot tree and Ben's access. Complete this small comic story in two chapters with a visible settled aftermath.

story_brief.genre_description: Gentle literary western with dry comedy
genre_requirements: Small practical stakes and warm character humor
A fair resolution without a villain
No compulsory technical crisis or public uprising
story_brief.audience: Adult readers of quiet comic fiction
story_brief.reader_promise: Two stubborn neighbors learn to solve a small problem together.
supporting_cast: Ben, a carpenter and Ada's neighbor
story_brief.ending_target: Ada and Ben build a shared gate, preserve the apricot tree and Ben's access, and share fruit beside the finished gate. Show the settled practical result.
avoid: A sequel cliffhanger replacing the ending
